PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier is a psychiatric outpatient clinic operating within the North Denmark Region (Region Nordjylland). It is recognized in the 2024 annual ADHD database report for its performance in the systematic quality measurement of ADHD treatment in Denmark [^src1]. 

The clinic is notable for achieving the highest departmental result for [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]], a newly introduced quality indicator focusing on pharmacological treatment among adults with ADHD [^src1]. PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Syd Ambulatorier reached a 100% compliance rate for this metric [^src1]. This achievement is considered highly robust because the clinic was one of the few departments to report a complete dataset, with exactly 20 out of 20 treatment courses accounted for in both the numerator and the denominator [^src1].
